register.reg_long_name: PLB Invalidate by Indices, EL1, Inner Shareable
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_S1POE2 is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Invalidates cached copies of IRT, TTT, and DPOT entries from PLBs that meet all the following requirements:

content.para: The entry matches the specified ASID.
If EL2 is implemented and enabled in the current Security state:

listitem.content: If HCR_EL2.{E2H, TGE} is not {1, 1}, the entry matches the current VMID, and the entry would be used in the EL1&0 translation regime in the current Security state.
If HCR_EL2.{E2H, TGE} is {1, 1}, and the entry would be used in the EL2&0 translation regime in the current Security state.

content.para: If EL2 is not implemented or not enabled in the current Security state, the entry would be used in the EL1&0 translation regime in the current Security state.
The entry is from the table type specified in the Structure field, and any of the following apply:

listitem.content: Structure specifies an IRT entry and all of the following apply: The entry is from a table specified by the P and U bits. The entry matches the specified TIndex value, if specified. The entry matches the specified FPOIndex value, if specified.

Structure specifies a TTT entry and all of the following apply: The entry is from a table specified by the P and U bits. The entry matches the specified POTIndex value, if specified. The entry matches the specified target TIndex value, if specified.

Structure indicates a DPOT entry and all of the following apply: The entry is from a table specified by the DPOT0 and DPOT1 bits. The entry matches the specified POTIndex value, if specified. The entry matches the specified DPOIndex value, if specified.

purpose_text.para: The invalidation applies to all PEs in the same Inner Shareable shareability domain as the PE that executes this System instruction.

attributes_text.para: PLBI PERME1IS, PLBI PERME1ISNXS is a 64-bit System instruction.

field_description.para: ASID value to match. Any appropriate PLB entries that match the ASID value will be affected by this System instruction.
Invalidate Privileged entries. If the Structure field indicates an IRT or TTT entry, this field controls whether the invalidation affects Privileged entries.
This field is ignored if the Structure field indicates a DPOT entry.

field_value_description.para: This value has no effect on the invalidation.

field_description.para: Invalidate Unprivileged entries. If the Structure field indicates an IRT or TTT entry, this field controls whether the invalidation affects Unprivileged entries.
This field is ignored if the Structure field indicates a DPOT entry.

field_value_description.para: This value has no effect on the invalidation.

field_description.para: Invalidate DPOT1 entries. If the Structure field indicates a DPOT entry, this field controls whether the invalidation affects DPOT1 entries.
This field is ignored if the Structure field indicates an IRT or TTT entry.

field_value_description.para: This value has no effect on the entries to invalidate.

field_description.para: Invalidate DPOT0 entries. If the Structure field indicates a DPOT entry, this field controls whether the invalidation affects DPOT0 entries.
This field is ignored if the Structure field indicates an IRT or TTT entry.

field_value_description.para: This value has no effect on the entries to invalidate.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
Level of Synchronization for perform for invalidated IRT entries.
This field is RES0 if the Structure field indicates an entry which is not a cached IRT entry.

field_value_description.para: Completion of this PLBI does not guarantee completion of outstanding instructions using the POTIndex of the cached IRT entries invalidated by this PLBI.
Completion of this PLBI guarantees completion of outstanding instructions using the POTIndex of the cached IRT entries invalidated by this PLBI.

field_description.para: The table structure for the entries to be invalidated.
All other values are reserved.
If this field is set to a reserved value, no PLB entries are required to be invalidated.

field_value_description.para: TTT by POTIndex and target TIndex.

field_description.para: TLBI Domain.
The following set of FEAT_TLBID behaviors apply to PLBI operations:

listitem.content: TLBI Domain numbering for PLBs matches that used for TLBs.
HCRX_EL2.{VTLBIDEn, VTLBIDOSEn} causes the TLBID value specified in PLBI instructions executed at EL1 to be transformed.
The effect of HCR_EL2.FB and HCRX_EL2.FNB on PLBI instructions executed at EL1 that specify the Inner shareable domain, or do not specify the Inner or Outer shareable domain.
The effect of SCTLR2_ELx.TLBOSNIS on PLBI OS instructions executed at EL1 and EL2.

field_description.para: Reserved, RES0.
Reserved, RES0.
Secondary filter.
If the Structure field is 0b0011, this field is the FPOIndex.
If the Structure field is 0b0111, this field is the DPOIndex.
If the Structure field is 0b1011, this field is the Target TIndex.
Otherwise this field is RES0.
Reserved, RES0.
Primary filter.
If the Structure field indicates an IRT entry, this field is the TIndex.
If the Structure field indicates a DPOT or TTT entry, this field is the POTIndex.

access_permission_text.para: This system instruction is an alias of the SYS instruction.

The following pseudocode describes traps which apply to the System instruction. For information about changes to the scope of the invalidation to the instruction under different conditions, see AArch64_PLBI_PERM() in the Pseudocode for AArch64 operation.
